exact_name_nonheading_hits.text: Core Chassis: Weight Shift, Spatial Awareness of down/anchor pressure, Weighted Strike, External Weight Shift
When you first learn the Sphere of Gravity, you gain Weight Shift and learn one Gravity talent for which you meet the prerequisites.
You may change modes only once on each of your turns unless a talent says otherwise. If you are Incapacitated, your Weight Shift becomes Neutral Weight.
You return to normal weight. Ending Weight Shift early requires no action on your turn.
When you use Weight Shift, you may spend 1 CP or Stamina to apply the same mode to one willing creature you touch.
A creature can benefit from only one Weight Shift at a time. If multiple Weight Shifts apply, the creature chooses which one remains.
While Gravitic Armor is active, your Weight Shift modes improve:
Your Field Art range is halved unless the target is adjacent to you, touching the ground you stand on, or affected by your Weight Shift.

While Body Heavying is active, your base Weight Shift damage bonus applies to the first melee hit you land each turn even if you moved more than half your Speed, as long as you moved in a straight line toward the target.
Weight Shift costs 1 CP or Stamina if you maintain Body Lightening or Body Heavying for more than one consecutive round.

#### Demon Seed
Classification: Forbidden Daemonic Root
Action Type: Bonus Action
Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 1 CP or 1 Stamina
Plant or awaken a Demon Seed in your body, dantian, meridians, or soul. The Seed is a forbidden method-root, not a Demon Core. It does not make you a demon; it opens the second furnace through which the daemonic scripture can breathe.
While Demon Seed is active:
your Daemonic talents may be used;
you gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus + your Daemonic key ability modifier;
once per turn when you hit with a weapon attack, Unarmed Strike, or Cultivation Attack, add 1d4 Necrotic, Psychic, or Force damage;
you have Advantage on saving throws against Frightened;
you have Disadvantage on checks made to appear spiritually pure unless you suppress all visible signs.
At CL 5, the extra damage becomes 1d6.
At CL 11, the extra damage becomes 1d8.
At CL 17, the extra damage becomes 1d10.
When Demon Seed ends, if you used Overdraw during its duration, make a Wisdom saving throw against your Daemonic Save DC. On a failure, gain 1 additional Corruption.
